experiments.name: sweep-graduations-combined
experiments.harness_commit: Identical frozen tail-current harness for both previously validated artifacts

plan.description: Combined forward-only leaf expansion, bound 32, branch veneers and register-only tail prefixes on top of recovered defaults 632c3d433; candidate is graduated and deployed runtime 7f5f85273. Both artifacts retain compiled SVC, sparse ROM lookup and outlined entry-budget defaults. Fixed measured frequency, ABBA/BAAB, no temperature gate or cooling wait.

campaign_context.decision: The combined additions since 632c3d433 improve Snakes CPU throughput 2.56% with all four pairs faster, but reduce Sky Force throughput 1.80% with two faster and two slower pairs. This is a measured tradeoff, not a demonstrated two-game win. Every valid observation is retained. The closing comparison makes no further promotion or rollback; the previously graduated runtime 7f5f85273 remains deployed. The Sky Force loss remains an explicit limitation requiring targeted isolation before claiming an overall two-game improvement.
